_comment: City of Toronto municipal development charges (DCs), curated from the City's published rate schedule. DCs are a city-wide flat schedule (NOT spatial, NOT zoning-dependent): a rate per residential dwelling unit by unit type, and a rate per square metre of non-residential ground-floor gross floor area. They change over time via indexing and bylaw amendments. UPDATE PROCEDURE: when the bylaw or indexing changes, APPEND a new object to `versions` with a new `effective_from`, set the previous version's `effective_to` to the day before, and bump `verified_date`. Old `as_of` dates keep resolving to the correct historical rates. Excludes Community Benefits Charge (s.37/CBC), parkland dedication (s.42), and education development charges by design.

versions.indexing_note: Per Council item MM29.16 (April 2025), Toronto held housing DC rates at their June 6, 2024 levels; the scheduled May 1, 2025 indexing (a 4% adjustment) does NOT apply to housing developments. Indexing remains paused pending the City's DC bylaw review and a new bylaw. The June 6, 2024 rates require a Section 27 agreement under the Development Charges Act to be locked in prior to building-permit issuance.
